basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex from Portland, Oregon. I'm a tech enthusiast and a cycling fanatic. I work as a software developer during the day and love exploring new trails on my gravel bike over the weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings diving into the latest gaming mods or catching up on tech news. I'm most active on Reddit from 7 PM to 11 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from Oregon State University, I've been working in the tech industry for over 5 years. My knowledge spans across software development, gaming hardware, and cycling gear. I've honed my skills through a combination of formal education and self-directed learning.
